disk_budget_note: The ESA-ADB README recommends at least 512 GB free for experiment artifacts and 32 GB RAM. This repo does not download the archive.
layout_note: A 2026-11-26 Zenodo listing showed ESA-Mission1.zip with channels/channel_N.zip, labels.csv, anomaly_types.csv, and telecommands/telecommand_N.zip. The listing stopped before later archives, so Mission2 and Mission3 checksums and archive names are not pinned. The benchmark README names folders ESA-Mission1 and ESA-Mission2 only.
